title: On the Difference Between a Large Stone and a Thousand Pebbles
coreMove: Check whether many small hits and one large hit have different consequences before aggregating them.
sourcePressure: This chapter opens nonlinearity by showing that concentrated and distributed impacts are not equivalent.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating nonlinearity as abstract math rather than a practical damage rule.

sourceAnchors.name: a large stone
sourceAnchors.detail: the source-note image for concentrated force and nonlinear damage
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: One large stone can break what a thousand pebbles merely tap.

sourceAnchors.name: a thousand pebbles
sourceAnchors.detail: the contrasting image for distributed effects that do not equal one concentrated blow
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The total weight is a trap if impact arrives in a different shape.
